ValidationRule.description: Block Support Coach from accessing FraudX case based on Coaching Workbench Roles-with an exception of KYC QA cases. User Sharing Rule might give users undesired access to FraudX case, so need this VR to block.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Fraud', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Identity', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Recipient_Mule', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Scam' ), Owner:User.UserRole.DeveloperName = 'Support_Coach' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This user does not have access to FraudX case.
